sections.text:
Main Cooling Water 
 Pump ( Vertical Pump )

This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
carried out 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.

The pump function is to cool the outlet steam from L.P turbine to convert the steam to 
condensate water, and also for cooling the closed cooling water for accessories .

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Raafat 
Abd Alla, reviewed by eng. Samy Kamal general director, revised 
by eng. 
Abouda Elbana 
EDEPC inspection and quality control 
engineer, and approved by eng. Moukhtar Mady head sector of Ataka PS

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
EDEPC 
inspection and 
quality control
general director and MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid. Manual puller
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometar, Straight edge, Rags
Check the discharge pressure and record it.
Check the vibration level of the pump and motor and record them
Dismantle bearing covers
Dismantle the non rotation.
Dismantle the thrust bearing.
Check the thrust bearing beds.
Dismantle the stuffing box housing
Check the run out of rotor.
Check the diameter of two sleeves
Check all parts for cracks
Inspect the validity of journal bearings and thrust bearing
Check the coupling parts
Clean impeller and shaft surfaces
Install the upper and lower sleeves
Mount the Impeller and nut and hub flange
Joint the suspension pipeline , guide casing and split ring
Mount the stuffing box bearing
Mount the stand still seal and its flange
Mount the bearing housing
Install bearing fixed part then put the bearing beds
Install the lower sleeve bearing.
Insert the packing rings and gland locking ring without working tighten.

Insert the adjustment nut and adjust the van clearance with splitring to not 
 less than ( 1 to 1.2 mm )
Install the coupling of pump.
Install the pump Rotor into it's casing and tight the nuts.
Attach the connection rod of coupling

Put the motor on its base and retarn the adjaust bolts on the original place 
 and tight the motor base bolts
Assemble the coupling parts and adjust the alignment.
Attach the coupling guard
Check the direction of rotation of pump
Check vibration levels.
Check bearing temperature
Tight the gland flange
Check the oil level.
